description: READ-ONLY: venue-held funds per linked wallet address — Hyperliquid (mode-aware total), Aster (keyless per-asset), dYdX (subaccount equity), Pacifica (account by Solana address), Polymarket (spendable pUSD + positions value). Reads are public and keyless against the EXPLICIT owner address (never an agent address); each row names the address it read. A failed venue nulls its leg — never a coerced 0. Omit venue to read every linked venue; totalUsd sums the legs that answered and partial:true names every leg that did not.

venue.description: Venue to read: dydx|hyperliquid|polymarket|aster|pacifica, or all (default). `hl` is accepted as an alias of hyperliquid. One row per venue per linked address; totalUsd sums the legs that answered.

name: read_venue_balances
title: Read venue-held balances
